title: Tidy the Downloads folder

steps.dry_run: move loose files in ~/Downloads into Images, Documents, Videos, Audio, Archives and Installers subfolders by extension; nothing is deleted or overwritten

postcondition.value: ^moved \d+ files into folders(, skipped \d+ that could not be moved)?$

undo: Files were only moved into subfolders of Downloads (Images, Documents, Videos, Audio, Archives, Installers) and can be dragged back to the Downloads folder; nothing was deleted.
